```lean
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : a ∉ s := ha
  apply h (insert a s) (insert_mem _ _ this)
  rw [Finset.image_insert]
  exact ⟨_, _, _⟩
· intro h'
  intros s t hst
  by_cases h1 : t ⊆ s
  · refine le_antisymm (h' _ _ _) (h' _ _ _)
    · exact hst
    · exact hst
    · exact h1
    · exact h1
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, h2⟩ := not_subset_iff.1 h1
    have : a ∉ s := ha
    have h3 : s ⊆ insert a s := subset_insert
    have h4 : insert a s = s ∪ {a} := rfl
    have h5 : s ∪ {a} = insert a s := rfl
    have h6 : ∀ b ∈ s, b < a → f b < f (insert a s) := h' _ _ _
    have h7 : ∀ b ∈ s, a < b → f a < f (insert a s) := h' _ _ _
    have h8 : ∀ b ∈ s, b < a → f b < f a := λ b hb hba, h6 b hb hba
    have h9 : ∀ b ∈ s, a < b → f a < f b := λ b hb hab, h7 b hb hab
    have h10 : StrictMonoOn f s := h' _ _ _
    have h11 : StrictMonoOn f (insert a s) :=
      strictMonoOn_insert_iff_of_forall_le _ _ _ _ _ h2
        (And.intro h8 h10)
    refine h11 _ _
    · exact h3
    · exact h4
```
